scope: index.html site-introduction: landing/navigation/preview/paths/method only; excludes Core lesson and dynamic exports

hero-intro.source: 第一次接觸圍棋也可以開始。先在右側合成局面做一個可逆選擇；它不會寫入課程紀錄，也不會被當成正式作答。
hero-intro.text: New to Go? Start with the example on the right. Reveal what follows from a possible move, then reset it. This synthetic preview does not count as a course answer or update your progress.

trust-first-response.text: First choice and corrections stay separate

preview-question.source: 哪裡能把兩塊空間真正分開？
preview-question.text: Where could Black try to separate these two spaces?

preview-warning.source: 金色是目前選點，不代表正確。
preview-warning.text: The gold marker shows a possible choice, not a confirmed answer.

preview-consequence.source: 兩塊空間仍共用同一個破壞點
preview-consequence.text: The two spaces still share a point where White can break in

preview-synthetic.source: 合成示範，不寫入 learner evidence、分數或課程進度。
preview-synthetic.text: Illustrative position only. It does not change your learning record, score or course progress.

entry-title.source: 第一次學圍棋，和已有基礎的人，不需要走同一條路。
entry-title.text: Start with the Go skills you already have

entry-explainer.source: 你可以依照現在的理解與目標，選擇一個起點。三個入口各自連到既有課程內容；它們不是棋力分級，也不保證學習結果。
entry-explainer.text: Choose a starting point based on what you want to practise. These paths link to existing lessons; they are not rank levels or promises of improvement.

entry-beginner-detail.source: 從氣、提子、連接與切斷開始
entry-beginner-detail.text: Learn liberties, captures, connections and cuts

entry-beginner-copy.source: 用最小的棋盤，學會圍棋最核心的規則與棋形。適合完全新手，或想重新打好基礎的你。
entry-beginner-copy.text: Use a small board to learn the rules and recognise basic shapes. Suitable if you are completely new to Go or returning to the basics.

entry-local-copy.source: 學會從局部棋形中，判斷哪一方有利、哪裡有風險，逐步培養計算與閱讀棋形的能力。
entry-local-copy.text: Look at a local position, identify risks for each side and practise reading the next few moves.

entry-wholeboard.text: Connect local decisions to the whole board

entry-wholeboard-copy.source: 在 9 路棋局中，練習全盤觀察、形勢判斷與策略選擇，將所學應用到完整對局。
entry-wholeboard-copy.text: Use 9×9 games to practise whole-board awareness, judgement and decisions in a complete game.

catalog-count.source: 目前課程：15 單元 · 19 課 · 106 題。這些數字只描述內容量，不代表學習成效或棋力。
catalog-count.text: Current catalogue: 15 units, 19 lessons and 106 Core items. These numbers describe content, not measured learning gains or playing rank.

method-title.source: 不是看做了幾題，而是看隔一段時間後還能不能自己做。
method-title.text: Can you make the decision again later, without a hint?

method-caveat.source: 這四步是本站採用的練習流程，不是對個人學習效果的保證；可用它安排觀察、作答、回看與換形再判。
method-caveat.text: These four steps organise practice and later checks. They do not guarantee that anyone has learned a skill.
